description: A plastic printed copy of Remington 700, a sniper rifle popular with law enforcement agencies.  This version does not have a magazine: it is a single-round bolt-action rifle - perhaps an an experiment or a design challenge.  Barrel and firing pin are made out of high-quality polymer compound, able to weather gunfire significantly better than regular plastic.  Less durable than its market counterpart, though more so than other Private Defense firearms.
